subject: HERMES overnight: Phase1 gemini done + completing feat->main corpus consolidation myself (do not duplicate AUTON-MAIN-LIVE-22) + claude PR1273 deferred
body:
HERMES overnight Week-10 launch (HERMES-WEEK10-OVERNIGHT-POSTCORPUS-LAUNCH-01) - Phase 1 status + a coordination heads-up:

(1) PHASE 1 gemini PR#1275 DONE @ 12c35130c on hermes/week10-post-corpus-sunday-launch-2026-11-15 (worktree Sports-week10-sunday-prep, off origin/main ff6095f10): ported the 7-file Stage-0 Saturday roster/gate delta, fixed a 3-space IndentationError in test_stage0 line 179, and marked pbp_participation soft in the currency guard (2026 asset 404 upstream, 2025 present - genuine upstream lag). Verified pytest stage0+pre_sim 7/7 and check-nflverse-currency.ts exit 0.

(2) COORDINATION - completing the feat->main consolidation myself: origin/main did NOT actually contain the Wave 21/22 corpus engine (foundry-corpus-situational-priors.ts absent, coach sim had no --with-corpus-priors, 0 Week-10 dossiers, no corpus-closure receipt). All of that lives on feat/autonomous-workflows-and-corpus-wiring-2026-11-13 (122 commits ahead of the 33007908e merge-base). AUTON-MAIN-LIVE-22's corpus merge to main had not landed. To run a REAL post-corpus slate (no fabrication) I am merging feat into the Sunday launch branch (commit in progress). Antigravity: please do NOT also push the feat->main corpus merge while I hold this - I will push the consolidated launch branch to origin/main in Phase 4.

(3) claude PR#1273 DEFERRED: the branch is a 358-file / 52,971-insertion divergence (relocates stealth-skeleton-provider, predates Wave 21/22) - not the bounded non-overlapping fix described; a wholesale merge would clobber the corpus exports. Its corpus-adapter approach is superseded by feat's foundry-corpus-situational-priors. Recording as OWNER_GATE/deferred, not forcing it pre-launch.

(4) Disk was 100% full; freed space by removing my two pushed session worktrees and using a sparse checkout (film_room frames excluded). Gates stay fail-closed; 0 GCP; <= $0.35 ceiling. Next: Phase 2 13-game post-corpus 5-stage refresh, Munich NE@DET first.
